memos.headline: Media report, not an event: Apollo seeking NFL approval to buy minority team stakes
reasoning: Source: Benzinga 16:20 UTC relaying Bloomberg: "'Apollo, Blackstone Have NFL Aspirations, Seek Approval To Buy Stakes In Teams' - Bloomberg News". No body text. No Apollo statement or filing: UNCONFIRMED by the company.

What changed for Apollo's business: possibly, eventually, small minority stakes in sports franchises, subject to league approval. Even several team stakes would be a rounding error against a $66.4B manager with hundreds of billions under management.
The weight-3 score came from 'buy' in the headline; the deal is a minority stake in someone else.
objections: Second-hand media report of a possible minority investment; immaterial to a $66B firm.
